## About me

<div class="about-bio">
<p>I'm a final-year Business Studies student at Dublin City University, specialising in Business Analytics. I'm passionate about the point where business questions meet technical problem-solving — using data to clarify what's happening, why it's happening, and what to do next.</p>
<p>My toolkit spans Python (Pandas/NumPy), SQL/MySQL, Power BI/Tableau, Excel, and web fundamentals including HTML/CSS. I enjoy the full analytical cycle: framing the business problem, building tidy data models, testing assumptions, and communicating insights that drive real decisions.</p>
<p>Outside of work and college, I'm a dedicated bodybuilder. The discipline and consistency that the sport demands carries into everything else I do.</p>
</div>
